businessSummary.en: Global payment network and value-added payment services; it does not lend cardholders the purchase principal.
businessSummary.zh: 全球支付网络与支付增值服务；不向持卡人出借消费本金。

growth.en: Payment volume, cross-border activity and services support durable growth; mature scale supports margins near the latest reported range. Litigation and regulation remain risks.
growth.zh: 支付规模、跨境活动与服务支持持续增长；成熟规模支持利润率接近近期申报区间。诉讼与监管仍是风险。

targetMargin.en: Payment volume, cross-border activity and services support durable growth; mature scale supports margins near the latest reported range. Litigation and regulation remain risks.
targetMargin.zh: 支付规模、跨境活动与服务支持持续增长；成熟规模支持利润率接近近期申报区间。诉讼与监管仍是风险。

tax.en: Normalized forward operating tax assumption; historical effective tax remains reported in history.
tax.zh: 前瞻正常化营业税率假设；历史有效税率仍按申报保留。

salesCapital.en: Analyst reinvestment assumption informed by the historical book-capital proxy. Incremental sales require new operating capital; accounting acquisitions and buybacks can distort historical ratios.
salesCapital.zh: 依据历史账面资本代理指标设定的分析师再投资假设。新增销售需要新增经营资本；并购会计与回购可能扭曲历史比率。

wacc.en: Analyst required-return assumption reflecting business cyclicality and financing risk; not a quoted market measurement.
wacc.zh: 反映业务周期及融资风险的分析师必要回报假设，并非市场报价测量值。

terminalGrowth.en: Long-run nominal growth assumption below the discount rate; competitive growth fades as the business matures.
terminalGrowth.zh: 低于折现率的长期名义增长假设；随着业务成熟，竞争性增长逐渐放缓。

terminalROIC.en: Analyst mature return on new capital; preserves reinvestment needed to fund terminal growth rather than assuming growth is free.
terminalROIC.zh: 分析师对成熟期新增资本回报率的假设；保留支持永续增长所需的再投资，不假设增长无需投入。

years.en: These are analyst starting assumptions, not company guidance or reported facts. Growth fades toward the terminal rate; stock-based compensation remains an expense.
years.zh: 这些是分析师起始假设，并非公司指引或申报事实。增长逐步收敛至永续增长率；股权薪酬仍计入费用。

limitations.en: operatingLeaseLiabilities: Current interim filing omits full operating lease liability split; annual operating lease liability retained as context only, not added to debt.
limitations.zh: 中期未完整拆分经营租赁负债，年度数仅作背景资料，不计入金融债务。

limitations.en: unvestedRSUs: Interim filing lacks complete award balance. Latest annual nonvested count retained as explicit dilution proxy; +/-25% award sensitivity should be shown.
limitations.zh: 中期未披露完整奖励余额，沿用最近年度未归属股数，作为明确的稀释代理；应展示奖励股数上下25%的敏感度。

limitations.en: options: Interim filing lacks full outstanding option roll-forward. Latest annual count and strike retained as proxy; annual market intrinsic value is stale and is not a current-period valuation.
limitations.zh: 中期未披露完整期权变动表，沿用最近年度期权数量及行权价；年度市场内在价值并非当前期末估值。

limitations.en: Finance leases are not separately quantified; no unverified extra liability is added. A $100m omitted liability would lower value by about $0.11 per share.
limitations.zh: 融资租赁未单独量化，因此未加入未经核实的额外负债。若遗漏1亿美元负债，每股价值约减少0.11美元。

limitations.en: Negative June noncontrolling book equity of $5m is not treated as a common-shareholder asset; the claim is floored at zero.

businessSummary.en: Credit ratings, indices, financial information and commodity data. These filed bases include Mobility through June 30, 2026, before its July 1 separation.
businessSummary.zh: 信用评级、指数、金融信息与大宗商品数据。申报基期包含2026年6月30日前的出行业务，该业务于7月1日分拆。

growth.en: Recurring subscriptions, ratings and indices support growth and strong margins. Historical merger accounting and the Mobility separation limit direct comparisons; this is the filed pre-separation group.
growth.zh: 经常性订阅、评级及指数业务支持增长与较高利润率。历史并购会计与出行业务分拆限制直接比较；本情景为分拆前申报集团。

targetMargin.en: Recurring subscriptions, ratings and indices support growth and strong margins. Historical merger accounting and the Mobility separation limit direct comparisons; this is the filed pre-separation group.
targetMargin.zh: 经常性订阅、评级及指数业务支持增长与较高利润率。历史并购会计与出行业务分拆限制直接比较；本情景为分拆前申报集团。

tax.en: Normalized forward operating tax assumption; historical effective tax remains reported in history.
tax.zh: 前瞻正常化营业税率假设；历史有效税率仍按申报保留。

salesCapital.en: Analyst reinvestment assumption informed by the historical book-capital proxy. Incremental sales require new operating capital; accounting acquisitions and buybacks can distort historical ratios.
salesCapital.zh: 依据历史账面资本代理指标设定的分析师再投资假设。新增销售需要新增经营资本；并购会计与回购可能扭曲历史比率。

wacc.en: Analyst required-return assumption reflecting business cyclicality and financing risk; not a quoted market measurement.
wacc.zh: 反映业务周期及融资风险的分析师必要回报假设，并非市场报价测量值。

terminalGrowth.en: Long-run nominal growth assumption below the discount rate; competitive growth fades as the business matures.
terminalGrowth.zh: 低于折现率的长期名义增长假设；随着业务成熟，竞争性增长逐渐放缓。

terminalROIC.en: Analyst mature return on new capital; preserves reinvestment needed to fund terminal growth rather than assuming growth is free.
terminalROIC.zh: 分析师对成熟期新增资本回报率的假设；保留支持永续增长所需的再投资，不假设增长无需投入。

years.en: These are analyst starting assumptions, not company guidance or reported facts. Growth fades toward the terminal rate; stock-based compensation remains an expense.
years.zh: 这些是分析师起始假设，并非公司指引或申报事实。增长逐步收敛至永续增长率；股权薪酬仍计入费用。

limitations.en: Dated group includes Mobility, separated on July 1, 2026; this is not the current standalone SPGI perimeter.
limitations.zh: 基期集团包含于2026年7月1日分拆的出行业务；并非当前独立标普全球的业务范围。

limitations.en: unvestedRSUs: Interim filing lacks complete award balance. Latest annual nonvested count retained as explicit dilution proxy; +/-25% award sensitivity should be shown.
limitations.zh: 中期未披露完整奖励余额，沿用最近年度未归属股数，作为明确的稀释代理；应展示奖励股数上下25%的敏感度。

limitations.en: options: Interim filing lacks full outstanding option roll-forward. Latest annual count and strike retained as proxy; annual market intrinsic value is stale and is not a current-period valuation.
limitations.zh: 中期未披露完整期权变动表，沿用最近年度期权数量及行权价；年度市场内在价值并非当前期末估值。

limitations.en: The June filing has no separate current-investment line. No additional value is assigned; the prior annual $56m balance is only about $0.19 per share.
limitations.zh: 6月申报未单列流动投资，不另行加值；上年度5600万美元余额仅相当于每股约0.19美元。

limitations.en: Redeemable minority interests of $4.917bn annual and $5.024bn June are deducted separately from ordinary minority equity.
limitations.zh: 年度49.17亿美元与6月50.24亿美元的可赎回少数股东权益，在普通少数股东权益之外单独扣除。

limitations.en: S&P Global earns fees from ratings, subscriptions, indices and data services; it is not a lending or deposit-taking institution. Operating free-cash-flow valuation is appropriate for this service business, with ordinary debt and minority claims separately deducted.
limitations.zh: 标普全球通过评级、订阅、指数与数据服务收取费用，并非贷款或吸收存款机构。该服务业务适用经营自由现金流估值，并单独扣除普通债务与少数股东请求权。

limitations.en: The annual filing reports fewer than 0.1m options and $5m intrinsic value, not an exact option count. The $5m disclosed claim is retained as a small proxy (about $0.017 per share); no invented option count is used.
limitations.zh: 年报披露期权少于10万份、内在价值500万美元，并未提供精确数量。保留已披露的500万美元请求权作为小额代理（约每股0.017美元），不编造期权数量。

reason.en: Equity-method earnings are already included in operating income; do not add affiliate carrying value again.
reason.zh: 权益法收益已计入营业利润；不再添加联营投资账面价值。

quoteScope.noteZh: 这些历史时点财务数据包含出行业务。分拆后的独立标普全球报价不可与此集团估值直接比较。

cautions: The denominator includes all outstanding BAM common shares after the reorganization, excluding treasury shares. Brookfield Corporation’s ownership of BAM is not another minority-interest deduction. Options on Brookfield Corporation are a different issuer’s shares and are not added to BAM.

The annual 16.3 million incremental diluted-EPS shares serve as a proxy for combined option and escrow dilution, not a reported period-end award count. Zero to twice this proxy tests an effect of roughly 1% on value per share. No separate option-value deduction is applied. Already-issued restricted stock and escrow-share cancellations must not be double counted.

Owner earnings retain stock-compensation costs and already reflect attributable ownership and financing costs. Consolidated fund assets, fund borrowings and minority interests are not added or deducted a second time.

The forecast assumes that each dollar of new required common equity supports $3 of fee revenue. The terminal 25% return applies to new incremental equity, not the entire existing book-equity balance. This lower terminal capital efficiency raises required retention; it does not assume an unfunded jump in the existing capital stock.

Fee revenue and owner earnings are reconciled non-GAAP business measures. The 2022 predecessor year is contextual because the reorganization and bundled compensation addback limit comparability; the 2023–2025 owner-earnings series is directly reconciled.
cautionsZh: 分母包含重组后全部BAM已发行普通股，扣除库存股。Brookfield Corporation持有BAM股份，不构成再次扣除的少数股东权益。Brookfield Corporation期权属于另一发行人，不计入BAM股份。

股东收益保留股权薪酬成本，并已反映应占持股比例及融资成本。合并基金资产、基金借款及少数股东权益不再重复加回或扣除。
预测假定每美元新增所需普通股资本支持3美元费用收入。永续期25%的回报率适用于新增边际股权资本，而非全部现有账面权益。永续期资本效率降低会提高所需利润留存，但不假定现有资本存量在未融资情况下突然增加。
费用收入与股东收益是经过调节的非公认会计准则业务指标。由于重组及合并披露的薪酬加回限制可比性，2022年前身年度仅供参考；2023–2025年股东收益可直接调节。

businessSummary.en: Membership warehouse retailer with high sales volume and low merchandise margins; membership fees support profitability.

growth.en: Warehouse growth, membership income and comparable sales support 7% starting growth. A 4% operating margin respects the low-margin retail model; high sales-to-capital reflects inventory turnover and supplier funding.
growth.zh: 仓库扩张、会员收入与同店销售支持7%的起始增长。4%的营业利润率符合低利润率零售模式；较高销售资本比反映存货周转与供应商融资。

targetMargin.en: Warehouse growth, membership income and comparable sales support 7% starting growth. A 4% operating margin respects the low-margin retail model; high sales-to-capital reflects inventory turnover and supplier funding.
targetMargin.zh: 仓库扩张、会员收入与同店销售支持7%的起始增长。4%的营业利润率符合低利润率零售模式；较高销售资本比反映存货周转与供应商融资。

tax.en: Normalized forward operating tax assumption; historical effective tax remains reported in history.
tax.zh: 前瞻正常化营业税率假设；历史有效税率仍按申报保留。

salesCapital.en: Analyst reinvestment assumption informed by the historical book-capital proxy. Incremental sales require new operating capital; accounting acquisitions and buybacks can distort historical ratios.
salesCapital.zh: 依据历史账面资本代理指标设定的分析师再投资假设。新增销售需要新增经营资本；并购会计与回购可能扭曲历史比率。

wacc.en: Analyst required-return assumption reflecting business cyclicality and financing risk; not a quoted market measurement.
wacc.zh: 反映业务周期及融资风险的分析师必要回报假设，并非市场报价测量值。

terminalGrowth.en: Long-run nominal growth assumption below the discount rate; competitive growth fades as the business matures.
terminalGrowth.zh: 低于折现率的长期名义增长假设；随着业务成熟，竞争性增长逐渐放缓。

terminalROIC.en: Analyst mature return on new capital; preserves reinvestment needed to fund terminal growth rather than assuming growth is free.
terminalROIC.zh: 分析师对成熟期新增资本回报率的假设；保留支持永续增长所需的再投资，不假设增长无需投入。

years.en: These are analyst starting assumptions, not company guidance or reported facts. Growth fades toward the terminal rate; stock-based compensation remains an expense.
years.zh: 这些是分析师起始假设，并非公司指引或申报事实。增长逐步收敛至永续增长率；股权薪酬仍计入费用。

limitations.zh: 沿用2025财年13.79亿美元私人及权益法投资余额作为代理；上下50%约影响每股0.65美元。不将递延薪酬计划资产重复计入。

limitations.en: operatingLeaseLiabilities: Current interim filing omits full operating lease liability split; annual operating lease liability retained as context only, not added to debt.
limitations.zh: 中期未完整拆分经营租赁负债，年度数仅作背景资料，不计入金融债务。

limitations.en: unvestedRSUs: Interim filing lacks complete award balance. Latest annual nonvested count retained as explicit dilution proxy; +/-25% award sensitivity should be shown.
limitations.zh: 中期未披露完整奖励余额，沿用最近年度未归属股数，作为明确的稀释代理；应展示奖励股数上下25%的敏感度。

limitations.en: Private investment carrying values are approximate economic values. The June $1.293bn deferred-compensation investments have matching plan liabilities and are excluded from excess assets.
limitations.zh: 私人投资账面值仅为经济价值的近似值。6月12.93亿美元递延薪酬投资对应计划负债，因此不计入多余资产。

businessSummary.en: Enterprise databases and cloud applications, with a rapidly expanding, capital-intensive AI cloud infrastructure business.
businessSummary.zh: 企业数据库与云应用，以及快速扩张、资本密集的AI云基础设施业务。

growth.en: 18% initial revenue growth is an analyst scenario supported by 17% FY2026 growth and 30% latest-quarter growth, then fades. $664bn remaining performance obligations are multi-year contracts, not current revenue or guaranteed profit.
growth.zh: 18%的初始收入增长为分析师情景，参考2026财年17%及最近季度30%的增长，随后逐渐放缓。6,640亿美元剩余履约义务属于多年合同，并非当期收入或保证利润。

targetMargin.en: 32% GAAP operating margin stays near the 32.1% TTM margin. Stock compensation, depreciation and operating lease expenses remain costs; AI capacity utilization and lease escalation can materially change margins.
targetMargin.zh: 32%的公认会计准则营业利润率接近过去12个月32.1%的水平。股权薪酬、折旧与经营租赁仍计入费用；AI产能利用率及租金上涨可能显著影响利润率。

tax.en: 20% normalized operating tax assumption avoids treating stock-exercise tax benefits and the Ampere disposal gain as recurring operating economics. Historical effective tax is retained separately.
tax.zh: 20%的正常化营业税率避免将行权税收优惠及Ampere出售收益视为持续经营因素。历史有效税率单独保留。

salesCapital.en: Capital-intensive starting assumption: $0.22 incremental revenue per $1 of net investment. FY2026 revenue increase of $9,958m divided by cash capex of $55,663m less depreciation of $7,623m is 0.207; TTM capex is $75,660m. This explicitly reflects the AI infrastructure build rather than historical software economics. Timing of capacity coming online and customer prepayments make this a scenario, not guidance.
salesCapital.zh: 资本密集型起始假设：每投入1美元净资本带来0.22美元新增收入。2026财年收入增加99.58亿美元，除以556.63亿美元现金资本支出减76.23亿美元折旧，得到0.207；过去12个月资本支出为756.60亿美元。该假设反映AI基础设施建设；产能投运时点与客户预付款使其属于情景而非指引。

wacc.en: 10% analyst required return reflects AI contract concentration, execution risk and substantial debt financing; it is not a quoted market WACC.
wacc.zh: 10%的分析师必要回报率反映AI合同集中、执行风险及大量债务融资，并非市场报价的加权平均资本成本。

terminalGrowth.en: 3% long-run nominal growth, below the discount rate, with growth fading as the infrastructure footprint matures.
terminalGrowth.zh: 3%的长期名义增长率低于折现率；基础设施成熟后增长逐步放缓。

terminalROIC.en: 15% mature marginal return is an analyst normalization, not the recent book return. It requires eventual utilization and lower incremental capital intensity; continuing today’s build intensity indefinitely would reduce value substantially.
terminalROIC.zh: 15%的成熟期边际资本回报率属于分析师正常化假设，并非近期账面回报。它要求最终提高产能利用率及降低新增资本强度；若当前建设强度永久持续，估值将显著下降。

years.en: Ten-year explicit forecast. Annual and TTM are dated conditional starting points; future financing, construction schedules and customer credit performance are scenario risks.
years.zh: 采用十年明确预测期。年度与过去12个月数据均为注明日期的条件性起点；未来融资、施工安排及客户信用表现属于情景风险。

limitations.en: The default keeps recent AI buildout intensity in the explicit forecast: sales-to-new-capital of 0.22 means about $4.55 of net reinvestment per $1 of incremental revenue. With current debt and other claims, this scenario produces negative modeled common equity, displayed at a zero floor. It is a conservative conditional scenario, not an assertion that Oracle is worthless. Post-buildout capital efficiency, customer funding and terminal assumptions materially change the result; historical book capital is contextual and is not substituted for future investment.
limitations.zh: 默认明确预测期保留近期AI建设强度：新增销售与资本比率0.22意味着每增加1美元收入需约4.55美元净再投资。结合当前债务及其他索偿，该情景得出负的模型普通股权益，并以零下限展示。这是审慎的条件性情景，并不意味着甲骨文毫无价值。建设完成后的资本效率、客户融资及永续假设会显著改变结果；历史账面资本仅作背景，不替代未来投资。

limitations.en: August 2026 restricted cash of $2,565m is excluded from excess cash. The 141m ATM shares and $19.9bn net proceeds are already in the August balance sheet and are not added again.
limitations.zh: 2026年8月25.65亿美元受限现金不计入多余现金。1.41亿股ATM发行及199亿美元净所得已体现在8月资产负债表，不再重复加入。

limitations.en: Short-term capex financing has no standalone reported closing balance. A conservative claim proxy assumes zero opening at FY2024 and accumulates net financing of $1,422m + $3,345m = $4,767m for May 2026 and subtracts $830m to reach $3,937m for August. The notes-payable schedule reconciles separately and excludes these cash flows. An omitted $1bn opening balance would reduce value by about $0.33/share; the full proxy is about $1.3–1.6/share.
limitations.zh: 短期资本支出融资未单列期末余额。审慎索偿代理假设2024财年期初为零，累计净融资14.22+33.45=47.67亿美元，8月再减8.30=39.37亿美元。应付票据明细独立核对，不含这些现金流。若遗漏10亿美元期初余额，估值约降低每股0.33美元；整项代理约为每股1.3至1.6美元。

limitations.en: The 31.238285m maximum mandatory preferred-conversion shares are an explicit conservative current-value proxy for a future market-price collar; the minimum 24.99063m sensitivity is available. Preferred carrying amount of $4,954m is not also subtracted. Remaining cumulative dividends are discounted separately at a 6.5% analyst rate; nominal payments provide a sensitivity.
limitations.zh: 最多3,123.8285万股强制优先股转换股份，为未来市场价格区间采用的审慎现值代理；提供最低2,499.063万股敏感度。不会再扣除49.54亿美元优先股账面值。剩余累积股息按6.5%的分析师利率单独折现，并提供名义支付额敏感度。

limitations.en: Annual 81m restricted awards and 21m options are carried into August because no complete interim rollforward is disclosed; 2.4m new awards were exceeded by 4m forfeitures/cancellations before vesting or exercises. Carrying annual counts is conservative, not an exact current count.
limitations.zh: 因中期未披露完整变动表，8月沿用年度8,100万份限制性奖励及2,100万份期权。240万份新增奖励少于400万份取消/没收，且未考虑归属或行权。沿用年度数量为审慎代理，并非精确当期数量。

limitations.en: Uncommenced data-center leases are $288bn at August and purchase obligations total $34.15bn. They are future operating and investment commitments, not added mechanically to current debt. Growth, margin and reinvestment must fund the capacity; contracted revenue can fail to translate into cash if customers default or construction slips.
limitations.zh: 8月尚未开始的数据中心租赁承诺为2,880亿美元，采购义务为341.5亿美元。它们属于未来经营及投资承诺，不机械加入当期债务。增长、利润率与再投资必须支持这些产能；客户违约或施工延期可能使合同收入无法转化为现金。

limitations.en: Net pension liability of $256m is included once and carried from May to August. Matched deferred-compensation investments and liabilities are excluded. Nonmarketable investment carrying amounts of $2.3bn/$2.4bn is a valuation proxy; a 50% haircut changes value by roughly $0.4/share.
limitations.zh: 2.56亿美元养老金净负债仅计入一次，并由5月沿用至8月。相匹配的递延薪酬投资与负债不计入。23/24亿美元非上市投资账面值为估值代理；减值50%约影响每股0.4美元。

limitations.en: FY2017/2018 were retrospectively restated for Topic 606 and pension presentation; FY2016 opening context was not. The transition is excluded from comparable historical growth/capital ranges. History is latest-reported context, not a point-in-time backtest.
limitations.zh: 2017/2018财年按Topic606及养老金列报追溯重述，2016财年期初资料未重述。该过渡期不纳入可比增长与资本范围。历史资料为最新申报背景，不属于时点回测数据。

limitations.en: Gross uncertain income-tax exposures and related interest/penalties total $13.2bn at May 2026. They are not all assumed immediately payable or deducted as debt; the timing and ultimate settlement remain a material tax sensitivity beyond the normalized 20% operating tax scenario.
limitations.zh: 2026年5月不确定所得税及相关利息罚款总敞口为132亿美元。未假设全部立即支付或作为债务扣除；支付时间与最终结算仍为正常化20%营业税率情景之外的重要税务敏感因素。

limitations.en: Customer prepayment funding reserve is 4,592m for May and 15,955m for August, shown separately from debt and restricted cash. Full, half and omitted reserve scenarios expose a material cash-conversion uncertainty. The reserve is a conservative gross cash-flow accumulation, not a separately reported closing balance.
limitations.zh: 客户预付款融资储备为5月45.92亿美元、8月159.55亿美元，与债务及受限现金分开列示。提供全部、半额及不保留储备的情景，展示重要现金转化不确定性。该储备是审慎累计现金流，并非单独披露的期末余额。

cautions.en: Option volatility 51% and rate 3.8% use FY2026 grant valuation assumptions as explicit proxies for outstanding claims. Rounded 5m vested and 15m expected-to-vest tranches do not reproduce the 20m subtotal weighted strike exactly. The conservative 1m residual uses strike 184.88 so (5×49.37 + 15×275.90 + 1×184.88) / 21 = 217.63; this is an allocation proxy from rounded values, not a separately reported tranche. Annual remaining lives are carried without aging at August.

businessSummary.en: AI servers, storage, networking and personal computers, with an integrated customer-financing business.
businessSummary.zh: AI服务器、存储、网络设备和个人电脑，并经营一体化客户融资业务。

growth.en: Initial growth of 12% reflects AI-server demand while deliberately fading the exceptional recent acceleration toward 2.5% long-run growth. It is an analyst scenario, not backlog converted mechanically into sales or management guidance.
growth.zh: 12%的初期增长反映AI服务器需求，同时将近期异常加速逐步收敛至2.5%的长期增长。这是分析师情景，并非将订单机械转换为收入或公司指引。

targetMargin.en: A 9% mature GAAP operating margin balances higher server scale against hardware competition and expensive GPU pass-through. Recent TTM margin is about 9.4%, versus 7.2% in FY2026; stock compensation and depreciation remain expenses.
targetMargin.zh: 9%的成熟期GAAP营业利润率平衡服务器规模效应、硬件竞争及昂贵GPU的转售成本。近期TTM约为9.4%，2026财年为7.2%；股权薪酬及折旧仍计入费用。

tax.en: 20% normalized operating tax is an analyst assumption near the FY2026 18.3% effective rate, without repeating FY2025 discrete statute-expiry and stock-compensation tax benefits.
tax.zh: 20%的正常化营业税率为分析师假设，接近2026财年18.3%的有效税率，不重复2025财年税务时效届满及股权薪酬的一次性税收利益。

salesCapital.en: Five dollars of incremental sales per dollar of new operating capital is a conservative analyst reinvestment assumption relative to supplier-funded book ratios. It explicitly funds inventory, customer financing and leased equipment; ongoing supplier credit is not assumed to make growth free.
salesCapital.zh: 每投入1美元新增经营资本支持5美元新增收入，相比依赖供应商资金的账面比率，这是较保守的分析假设。再投资需支持库存、客户融资及出租设备，不假设供应商信用使增长无需投入。

wacc.en: 10.5% is an analyst blended required return for a leveraged, cyclical hardware business with customer credit and AI-capacity concentration risk; not a measured market quote.
wacc.zh: 10.5%是分析师对具杠杆、周期性硬件业务的综合必要回报假设，考虑客户信用及AI产能集中风险，并非市场报价。

terminalGrowth.en: 2.5% nominal long-run growth assumes a mature global computing supplier and stays below the discount rate.
terminalGrowth.zh: 2.5%的长期名义增长假设对应成熟的全球计算设备供应商，并低于折现率。

terminalROIC.en: 18% return on new terminal capital is an analyst assumption, not distorted historical book ROIC. Terminal growth still requires reinvestment.
terminalROIC.zh: 18%的终值新增资本回报率是分析师假设，并非失真的历史账面ROIC；永续增长仍需要再投资。

years.en: Ten forecast years allow exceptional AI-server growth to fade. These are editable analyst starting assumptions; the filing data remain reported facts.
years.zh: 十年预测期让异常AI服务器增长逐渐放缓。这些是可编辑的分析师起始假设；申报数据仍保留为报告事实。

limitations.en: Whole-enterprise FCFF includes DFS financing income in revenue and subtracts all consolidated corporate and DFS debt once. DFS borrowing interest is below EBIT. Financing receivables and customer leased equipment are operating capital, never added again as surplus investments.
limitations.zh: 全企业FCFF包括收入中的DFS融资收益，并仅扣除一次全部公司及DFS债务。DFS借款利息列于营业利润以下。融资应收款和客户出租设备属于经营资本，不重复计为多余投资。

limitations.en: FY2026 book equity is negative after repurchases. Large payables and supplier-finance balances support working capital; use the explicit reinvestment assumption rather than treating a high book sales/capital ratio as free growth. Supplier finance of $1.98bn annual and about $3.1bn July remains trade payables, as filed, without a second debt deduction.
limitations.zh: 2026财年回购后账面权益为负。大额应付账款及供应商融资支持营运资本，应使用明确的再投资假设，不将高账面销售资本比视为免费增长。年度19.8亿美元及7月约31亿美元供应商融资按申报保留为贸易应付款，不重复扣为债务。

limitations.en: July carries 19 million annual RSU/PSU units because the interim filing omits a complete award roll-forward; PSUs are at target, with possible 0%-200% vesting. A +/-25% total-award scenario tests roughly 0.7% of allocation shares. Fractional rounding and small deferred units are below about 0.1% of shares.
limitations.zh: 7月沿用年度1900万份RSU/PSU，因季报未披露完整奖励变动；PSU按目标计量，可能归属0%-200%。总奖励上下25%情景对应约0.7%的分配股数。小数四舍五入及少量递延股份低于约0.1%的股数。

limitations.en: The 2.5 million COO options at $141.77 require market-capitalization, adjusted free-cash-flow and service conditions. The model conservatively assumes full vesting and values contractual time remaining at the modeled share price; $132m grant-date fair value is not deducted again.
limitations.zh: 250万份COO期权行权价141.77美元，需满足市值、调整后自由现金流及服务条件。模型保守假设全部归属，并按模型股价及剩余合约期估值；不重复扣除1.32亿美元授予日公允价值。

limitations.en: The $248m international pension deficit is included once as a separate claim and carried to July; a 50% change moves value by about $0.19 per share. Annual finance leases are disclosed as immaterial; $100m omitted debt would move value about $0.15 per share.
limitations.zh: 2.48亿美元国际养老金缺口作为独立索偿计入一次，并沿用至7月；变动50%约影响每股0.19美元。年报披露融资租赁不重大；若遗漏1亿美元债务，约影响每股0.15美元。

limitations.en: Strategic investments of $1.73bn annual and $2.679bn July are added once at carrying value; private securities may realize different prices. The $0.6bn July YTD investment gains sit below EBIT and are not projected as operating earnings.
limitations.zh: 年度17.3亿美元及7月26.79亿美元战略投资按账面值仅加计一次；私人证券实际变现价格可能不同。7月累计6亿美元投资收益列于营业利润以下，不外推为经营盈利。

targetMargin.zh: 成熟期GAAP营业利润率37%，接近2025财年的36.6%，高于2026财年前九个月的35.4%。该假设保留股权薪酬及收购无形资产摊销；AI推理成本与销售投入可能限制利润率提升。

businessSummary.en: Bloom supplies on-site solid-oxide fuel-cell power systems, installation and long-term service. AI data-center power demand is accelerating sales, while manufacturing expansion, working capital, customer concentration and project timing remain central risks.
businessSummary.zh: Bloom提供现场固体氧化物燃料电池发电系统、安装及长期服务。AI数据中心电力需求推动销售加速，但扩产、营运资本、客户集中及项目进度仍是核心风险。

sources.title: Bloom Energy Q 32025 Form 10-Q, affiliate-profit elimination comparator

growth.en: 30% initial growth fading toward 3% is an analyst scenario below nine-month 2026 growth 145%; it recognizes AI power demand without extrapolating one year of rapid deployment indefinitely.
growth.zh: 初期30%增长逐步收敛至3%，为低于2026年前九个月145%增长的分析情景；反映AI供电需求，但不无限外推单年快速部署。

targetMargin.en: 18% mature operating margin is a normalized analyst scenario after affiliate-profit eliminations, stock compensation and customer incentives. It requires improvement from normalized FY 2025 margin 1.6% and TTM 13.8%; Q 32026 reported 18.2% is context, not a directly comparable cash margin. Installation losses, service obligations and competition limit profitability.
targetMargin.zh: 18%成熟期营业利润率为扣除合资利润抵消、股权薪酬及客户激励后的正常化分析情景，要求从正常化2025年1.6%及TTM13.8%改善。2026第三季度申报18.2%仅作背景，并非直接可比现金利润率。安装亏损、服务义务及竞争限制盈利能力。

tax.en: 23% normalized tax is an analyst assumption for sustainable profitability. Historical low taxes reflect losses and allowances; no separate NOL asset is added.
tax.zh: 23%正常化税率为持续盈利的分析假设。历史低税额受亏损与估值准备影响；不另加亏损结转资产。

salesCapital.en: 1.5 x incremental sales to capital funds gross manufacturing, inventory and receivable growth without assuming recurring customer-advance financing. Nine-month 2026 capex 231 m and working-capital expansion argue against software-like capital efficiency. Existing deposits are separately reserved once.
salesCapital.zh: 新增销售与资本比1.5倍为制造、库存及应收款增长总额提供资金，不假设重复客户预付融资。2026年前九个月资本开支2.31亿美元及营运资本扩张不支持采用软件式资本效率。现有预付款另行保留一次。

wacc.en: 11.5% discount rate is an editable analyst required return reflecting concentrated project demand, manufacturing execution, fuel economics, leverage and dilution; it is not live market-derived WACC.
wacc.zh: 11.5%折现率是可编辑分析必要回报，反映项目需求集中、制造执行、燃料经济性、杠杆及稀释风险，并非实时市场推导WACC。

terminalGrowth.en: 3% terminal growth assumes a mature power-equipment business and requires ongoing reinvestment.
terminalGrowth.zh: 3%永续增长假设企业成为成熟电力设备业务，并保留持续再投资。

terminalROIC.en: 15% marginal terminal capital return assumes an established manufacturing and service franchise with continuing competition; historical loss years are not calibration targets.
terminalROIC.zh: 15%永续期边际资本回报假设成熟制造及服务业务仍面临竞争；历史亏损年度不作为校准目标。

years.en: Ten forecast years allow deployment growth and margins to mature while capital intensity remains explicit.
years.zh: 十年预测期允许部署增长及利润率逐步成熟，同时明确保留资本投入。

normalizationDelta.en: Starting operating income excludes own-share product profit on sales to unconsolidated affiliates that the filing eliminates below EBIT; raw GAAP figures remain visible. TTM uses the rounded 16.9 m current-period elimination.
normalizationDelta.zh: 起始营业利润排除公司在营业利润以下抵消的、向未并表合资销售产生的自身份额利润；原始GAAP数字保持可见。TTM采用舍入披露的当期1690万美元抵消额。

cautions.en: Reported RSU/PSU counts are assumed to vest. Conditional performance multipliers beyond disclosed outstanding units and ungranted share-pool capacity are excluded. Existing EPP derivative liability and unfunded JV commitments are deducted once at reported amounts; no new investment value is assumed for the commitments.
cautions.zh: 假设披露RSU/PSU全部归属；不计入超出披露未归属单位的条件性业绩倍数或未授予股份池。现有EPP衍生负债及未缴合资资本承诺按披露金额扣除一次，未假设未来注资创造额外投资价值。

note.en: Reserve the full reported customer-deposit balance as conservative operating funding:78.207 m annual and 661.354 m September. These are deposits from Note 3 contract balances, separate from deferred revenue 65.608 m/93.026 m; they are neither legally restricted cash nor an additional debt claim. Gross deposits may exceed remaining cash fulfillment costs. The 1.5 x sales-to-capital assumption funds gross incremental operating investment without assuming repeat customer-advance funding; full, half and no reserve sensitivities show the uncertainty.

limitations.en: Use the filed September 30,2026 balance sheet and nine-month results, filed October 22. TTM is FY 2025 plus 2026 nine months minus 2025 nine months; it is not a provisional earnings-release base.
limitations.zh: 使用10月22日正式提交的2026年9月30日资产负债表及前九个月业绩。TTM为2025全年加2026前九个月减2025前九个月，并非业绩新闻稿临时口径。

limitations.en: September cash includes large customer deposits funding future deliveries; not all cash is economically idle. Growth requires substantial inventory, contract assets and manufacturing investment, so the sales-to-capital assumption and cash-reserve sensitivity matter.
limitations.zh: 9月现金包含用于未来交货的大额客户预付款，并非全部属于经济上闲置现金。增长需要大量库存、合同资产及制造投资，因此销售资本比假设及现金储备敏感性重要。

limitations.en: September customer-consideration asset 306.500 m is prepaid share-based selling consideration, not surplus cash or an investment. Oracle cashless exercise plus incentive shares 2.154231 m is already in actual common; the old warrant is not charged again. Future amortization reduces revenue and target margins retain customer-incentive costs.
limitations.zh: 9月客户对价资产3.065亿美元为预付股份销售对价，不是闲置现金或投资。Oracle无现金行权及激励股份215.4231万股已计入实际普通股，不再扣除旧权证。未来摊销冲减收入，目标利润率保留客户激励成本。

limitations.en: Unconsolidated Fund JV investments are added at carrying value and unfunded capital commitments are deducted. Fund JV debt is nonrecourse and not consolidated; deferred intra-entity profit is an accounting elimination, not a second cash debt. Consolidated Korean JV debt and minority interest remain in the bridge.
limitations.zh: 未并表基金合资投资按账面价值加入，并扣除未缴资本承诺。基金合资债务无追索且未并表；递延内部利润为会计抵消，并非第二笔现金债务。已并表韩国合资债务及少数股东权益保留在估值调整中。

limitations.en: Supplier commitments of 5.8 bn over multiple years support planned production and are not added wholesale as debt; inventory and equipment purchases belong in forecast reinvestment. Customer concentration, performance guarantees and demand shortfalls can materially change the outcome.
limitations.zh: 多年供应商承诺58亿美元用于计划生产，不整体计为债务；库存和设备采购计入预测再投资。客户集中、性能保证及需求不及预期可能显著改变结果。

limitations.en: Capped-call coverage 33.549508 m uses the annual disclosed contract carried forward because the September filing refers to the same terms and discloses no termination. It is a separate derivative even though the 2028 notes are now redeemed; omit-hedge sensitivity tests this residual uncertainty.

limitations.en: Reserve the full reported customer-deposit balance as conservative operating funding:78.207 m annual and 661.354 m September. These are deposits from Note 3 contract balances, separate from deferred revenue 65.608 m/93.026 m; they are neither legally restricted cash nor an additional debt claim. Gross deposits may exceed remaining cash fulfillment costs. The 1.5 x sales-to-capital assumption funds gross incremental operating investment without assuming repeat customer-advance funding; full, half and no reserve sensitivities show the uncertainty.
limitations.zh: 按完整披露客户预付款余额保留审慎营运资金：年度7820.7万美元、9月6.61354亿美元。金额来自附注3合同余额，与递延收入6560.8万美元/9302.6万美元分开；并非法律受限现金或额外债务索偿。预付款总额可能高于剩余履约现金成本。销售资本比1.5倍为新增经营投资总额提供资金，不假设持续客户预付融资；完整、半额及不保留储备敏感性展示不确定性。

limitations.en: Reported debt retains all book financing obligations. A conservative carrying-value stress adds back 200.511 m annual/149.301 m September to model debt, instead of assuming the noncash financing residual offsets Energy Server assets at expiry. This changes only the valuation bridge; original filings remain intact.

ttm.adjustmentReason: Deduct approximately 37.722 m of TTM own-share affiliate-sale profit: FY 2025 elimination 40.421 m plus nine-month 2026 elimination 16.9 m minus nine-month 2025 elimination 19.599 m. Do not subtract all equity-method losses or the future release a second time.

debtDefinition.en: Modeled debt includes net carrying borrowings, finance leases and the disclosed present value of contractual managed-service financing principal. Reported book financing obligations also contain noncash residuals of $200.511 m annual/$149.301 m September expected to offset Energy Server assets at expiry; those residuals are excluded from the model and retained in the source facts. To stress full book debt, add that residual to other claims for the selected base.
debtDefinition.zh: 模型债务包含净账面借款、融资租赁及披露的托管服务合同融资本金现值。申报账面融资义务另含年度2.00511亿美元/9月1.49301亿美元非现金残值，预计到期时与发电设备资产抵消；模型排除此残值，原始事实完整保留。若测试完整账面债务，可在所选基期的其他索偿中加入对应残值。
